text:
michelle: Heads-up — kickoff for AWS/GCP/Azure listing prep. Need to align pricing tiers, trial entitlements, and regional constraints. Who can own AMI/VM image sizes and legal EULA wording? cc @olivia

sam: I can take pricing tiers. Quick q — 14-day vs 30-day trial? Sales prefers 14, marketplace often expects 30 in EU. Also: what's required for metering on Azure/GCP? Azure wants a meter GUID.

olivia: From legal: we need explicit data-processing + export-control clauses in the marketplace EULA. I'll draft the standard with a marketplace addendum. Note: marketplace clickwraps can't be materially changed after publish, so we need final SKUs ASAP.

raj: For images: AWS needs AMI names + account share. GCP needs image family and project. We should include a startup flag to signal license acceptance. Example startup snippet:```#!/bin/bash
/opt/redwood/start --accept-marketplace-license```
Also: provide two image variants (minimal, optimized) to support Dedicated vs hosted.

michelle: @raj can you prepare the minimal + optimized images and post test images to staging bucket? We'll reference them in the listing.

anna: Azure note — pricing requires a meter ID and offer ID. We can publish a single SKU cross-region but must include localized price overrides. Also confirm whether we want BYOL vs included support for Dedicated instances.

ellie: Entitlement mapping note: trials will be represented as a 30-day entitlement in billing, but product can gate feature flags. Need mapping table: SKU -> entitlement_id -> trial_days -> meter_id. If we choose 14-day trial in product, reconcile with 30-day marketplace entitlement (shorter product timeout wins).

sam: I'll own the mapping table and pricing sheet. Proposed columns: SKU, display_name, plan_tier, trial_days, meter_id, region_overrides, price_localized_link. I'll link a Google sheet shortly.

olivia: Please get me the SKU list by EOD Friday so legal can finish the marketplace EULA addendum. Also flag any export-controlled regions (CN, RU) if they restrict availability.

raj: Uploaded test images to s3://rwd-marketplace/images/1768203030-test/ — ping me for IAM share. Also added AMI name pattern: `redwood-inference-<model>-<variant>-<yyyyMMdd>`

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to marketplace-staging on 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC — changeset#MKT-520

michelle: Thanks all. Action items: sam = pricing + mapping sheet, raj = images & startup flag + IAM share, olivia = EULA draft, anna = meter GUIDs & offer IDs, ellie = entitlement mapping spec. Update this thread with artifacts and put final SKU list in the sheet. :thumbsup:
